objective.name: sandbox.py.unknown_cap
objective.description: Capacity whose handler name is not registered in the Python wrapper — used to test error propagation

#root.role: Select a wrapper-backed capacity name that the Python wrapper does not implement and expose the propagated error path.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The interpreted wrapper runtime may be started lazily.
effects.wrapper_dispatch: The wrapper dispatch path is exercised and expected to return an explicit unknown-capacity error.

transformation_contract.morphing: An interpreted execution request becomes an explicit propagated wrapper error when the capacity name is not implemented by the wrapper.
invariants: sandbox.py.unknown_cap must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.py.unknown_cap returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.py.unknown_cap fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.

subjective.intent: prove wrapper error response is propagated intact to the caller
